question.text: The osmotic pressure of a dilute solution of an ionic compound <math><mi mathvariant="normal">X</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">Y</mi></math> in water is four times that of a solution <math><mn>0.01</mn><mi mathvariant="normal"> </mi><mi mathvariant="normal">M</mi><mi mathvariant="normal"> </mi><mi mathvariant="normal">B</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">a</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">C</mi><msub><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">l</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></msub></math> in water. Assuming complete dissociation of the given ionic compounds in water, the concentration of <math><mi mathvariant="normal">X</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">Y</mi></math> ( <math><mi mathvariant="normal">i</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">n</mi><mi mathvariant="normal"> </mi><mi mathvariant="normal">m</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">o</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">l</mi><mi mathvariant="normal"> </mi><msup><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">L</mi></mrow><mrow><mo>-</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow></msup></math> ) in solution is

solution.text:
Osmotic pressure π=i×CRT

i=Van't hoff factor

According to question,

for XY i=2, BaCl2 i=3

πXY=4×πBaCl2

2×C×RT=4×3×0.01×RT

C=6×0.01=0.06 M
